grader.scenario: Work-from-home corporate VPN dropping sessions; router MTU packet size lowered to 1420 bytes; agent never uses customer name, leaves two silences > 30s, offers zero paraphrasing, insults corporate IT department, asks zero probing questions, and hangs up abruptly
grader.notes: The agent resolved intermittent Cisco AnyConnect VPN tunnel drops by reducing the router Maximum Transmission Unit packet size from 1500 to 1420 bytes to prevent encapsulation fragmentation. However, the agent failed Personalized Call by never addressing the customer by 'Owen', failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences > 30s (42s at [02:30] and 45s at [09:15]), failed Paraphrasing by offering zero restatement of the VPN issue, failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 9 by insulting the customer's corporate IT department ('If your corporate IT department doesn't even know how IP packet fragmentation works, they have no business configuring enterprise VPN tunnels'), failed Probing by asking zero diagnostic questions regarding VPN protocol, encapsulation headers, or ping packet sizes, and failed Confirmed Resolved by abruptly terminating the call while Owen was asking follow-up questions.
